info.title: reverse-skill
info.summary: Operate local IDA Pro MCP, Forefy ASR, and bounded routing evolution.

command.name: reverse-skill
command.description: Operate IDA Pro MCP, audited Forefy ASR items, and bounded routing evolution against local fixtures.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit one JSON output envelope on stdout.

exitCodes.description: Required local environment or executable unavailable.
MCP transport/protocol or ASR transport failure.
Operation-level failure, including invalid TraceCard content or MCP tool errors.

commands.name: asr
commands.description: Forefy ASR: audited skills, goals, and workflows only; exclude MCP servers. Publishing and --mine use FOREFY_API_KEY.

commands.name: author
commands.description: Read a GitHub owner's profile and audited items.

commands.name: authors
commands.description: List contributors with audited top items.

commands.name: create-goal
commands.description: Publish a structured goal JSON definition using FOREFY_API_KEY.

commands.name: import-repo
commands.description: Publish repository skills, goals, and workflows using FOREFY_API_KEY.

options.name: --path
options.description: Limit publishing to these path prefixes.

commands.name: install
commands.description: Save audited raw files into a new directory without running them.

commands.name: install-script
commands.description: Retrieve the upstream install script for review.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List audited skills, goals, and workflows, following every page by default.

options.name: --search
options.description: Search names, descriptions, authors, and repository URLs.

commands.name: plugin
commands.description: Inspect a bundle's audited skill members and supply-chain verdicts.

commands.name: record-download
commands.description: Record an audited item's download in the registry.

commands.name: scan
commands.description: Submit a public repository scan and return its id for scan-result.

commands.name: scan-result
commands.description: Fetch or poll a scan's findings, quality checks, and AI-slop score.

commands.name: scans
commands.description: List recent security and quality scans (a scan is not a human audit).

commands.name: show
commands.description: Read an audited item's metadata and raw files.

commands.description: Install ida-pro-mcp and run its interactive installer.

commands.description: Register the HTTP endpoint with Codex.

commands.description: Start or reuse the local IDA MCP service.

options.name: --replace-stale
options.description: Replace an unhealthy Windows listener only after verifying its executable and port.

commands.description: Report IDA, MCP negotiation, and Codex registration.

commands.description: Alias for status.

commands.name: tools
commands.description: List dynamically discovered MCP tools.

commands.name: integrations

commands.name: yara-scan
commands.description: Scan a binary with YARA and optionally annotate its active IDA database.

options.name: --annotate
options.description: Append comments for unique byte matches in IDA.

commands.name: open
commands.description: Open a binary through idb_open.

commands.name: sessions
commands.description: List active and discovered IDA database sessions.

commands.name: call
commands.description: Call a dynamically discovered MCP tool.

commands.name: close
commands.description: Close an IDA database session.

commands.name: tracecard-validate
commands.description: Validate TraceCard semantics without verifying the truth of external evidence.

commands.name: evolve
commands.description: Evaluate and reflect routing candidates with the configured OMP model; never promotes candidates.

options.name: --max-evaluations
options.description: Full fixture-suite evaluations, including baseline and curated; calls scale with fixture count.

options.name: --max-reflections
options.description: Separate reflection budget; maximum logical calls = evaluations x fixtures + reflections. Provider retries may add requests.
